description: We are the Stellar Explorer team from  Space Lab, Krishna Vikash Residential School. We are interested in astronomy, space science, robotics, and technology. We enjoy exploring new ideas, solving problems, and learning new things.We are excited to connect with students who share our passion for science and space exploration. We welcome members who are interested in coding, research, designing, data analysis, or coming up with innovative ideas. Together, we hope to learn, collaborate, and create
